answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, released only after three unrelated confirmations, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Reaching the onyx of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Every claim climbs the sable of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the tide re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
